description: How much of a country is inside mapped protected areas, and how close is nature to a big city?. Protected share of land per country (OpenStreetMap protected-area polygons, overlaps counted once) with counts of World Heritage, Ramsar, biosphere reserve, UNESCO Global Geopark and national park designations from Wikidata; plus a nature access score for the 120 largest cities. Not derived from WDPA. Routes: /; /answer (country, city); /cities (country, limit, offset); /countries (limit, offset, order). Paid $0.5 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.

route.description: One of: /, /answer, /cities, /countries. Replace {placeholders} with a value, e.g. /search or /HND.

name: protected-areas
